title: MQTT-SN Python codec
description:
spec/07-transport-app.md references MQTT-SN (port 10883) but no implementation exists. Implement publish/subscribe codec, topic registration, QoS handling per OASIS MQTT-SN 1.2 spec.

Deliverable: python/src/lichen/mqttsn/ module with encoder/decoder for CONNECT, PUBLISH, SUBSCRIBE, PINGREQ and corresponding tests
close_reason: Created src/lichen/mqttsn/ module: messages.py (22 dataclasses), codec.py (encode/decode), plus 85 tests. Full OASIS MQTT-SN 1.2 support.
